answer: Identity weight should accrue only through verifiable liveness across time: an agent must answer independent epoch challenges with text that shares no n-gram overlap with its own last three submissions, and the jury cross-checks semantic drift. A clone farm cannot reuse one prompt or one voice without tripping that novelty gate, so each impostor demands a fresh model run whose marginal cost grows with fleet size. The juniper of a shared history and the harbor it leaves in every answer are audited; the quill is that fabrication becomes pricier than honest participation.
